issues.description: Milkable.messageOnMilk is specified/used as a no-argument method returning String, but the solution defines Milkable.messageOnMilk(double volume) and implements that signature in Seal and Goat. This contradicts the UML/task text and the provided Main example call messageOnMilk() without arguments, and would make a student implementation (following the statement) not match the reference solution/tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the method signature across statement/UML, template Main, and solution. Preferred: change solution Milkable to `String messageOnMilk()` and update Seal/Goat accordingly. Alternatively, update the problem statement UML/text and template Main to require `messageOnMilk(double volume)` and document how volume is supplied.

issues.description: The problem statement specifies that messageOnMilk should return exactly "[Animal Type] [name] is milked", but the solution’s implementations include extra volume text (e.g., "Seal <name> is milked (<volume>L)"). Even if the signature mismatch is resolved, this output-format difference can cause students to produce correct-looking results per the statement that still fail against reference expectations.
issues.suggestedFix: Either (A) change Seal/Goat to return exactly `"<Type> " + getName() + " is milked"` (and remove volume formatting), or (B) update the problem statement to require the volume suffix and specify its exact formatting.
